description:
The POST carries the faithful envelope — `from`, `to`, `subject`, `text_body`, `html_body`, ordered headers, base64-encoded attachments, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC results — so downstream code sees everything the original message had. For a compact `{title, body, type, format}` notification instead of the full envelope, use the `smtp-to-msg` service.

Multi-channel: the free `byok` channel forwards every message to one receiver you store once as customer secrets (`SMTP_HTTP_RELAY_BASE_URL`, optional `SMTP_HTTP_RELAY_API_KEY`), while the metered `plus` channel runs many email-to-webhook routes under a single account — each enrollment binds its own destination `base_url` and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` address. See “How to use this service” for both channels.
name: smtp-to-http

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own HTTP receiver

summary: SMTP-to-HTTP bridge: receive email through the UnitySVC SMTP gateway and forward the full, lossless email envelope as an HTTP POST to your own endpoint — no SDK required.
